channel.title: Times of San Diego - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Times of San Diego (timesofsandiego.com)

item.title: In a first, SDHS releases hoary bat equipped with tracker
item.description: The adult male bat was rescued in near the coast during last month's storm on Nov. 14 and taken to the Humane Society for care.

item.title: Ailing drug dealer may serve time in a prison hospital after deaths of two in North Park
item.description: The attorney for Scott Anthony Sargent wrote to the judge saying his client may not survive a lengthy term due to illness.

item.title: Keep It Saucy! Swedish holiday dishes for that swinging ’60s Ann-Margret vibe
item.description: I have childhood memories of Christmas Eve with my Swedish neighbors. Ingrid was the best cook. In her honor, I present two of her recipes.

item.title: Opinion: The fiscalization of Balboa Park threatens the soul of San Diego
item.description: The paid parking implementation did not take into consideration any understanding of what Balboa Park is, or what the park provides to our citizenry.

item.title: County health officials warn of baby formula tied to botulism outbreak
item.description: San Diego County health officials issued a warning regarding a line of baby formula products that have been linked to a nationwide outbreak of infant botulism.

item.title: MTS still projects major budget shortfall despite strong ridership gains
item.description: Of the 25 major transit hubs across the nation, MTS has the second-fastest growing ridership, but is looking at a $120 million deficit by 2029.

item.title: Hope in the herd: Safari Park welcomes two endangered foals
item.description: The pair are the first to be born at the Safari Park since 2023, and they can be spotted by guests in the Asian Plains exhibit.

item.title: Rep. Darrell Issa to stay in California after flirting with House run in Texas
item.description: After flirting with the idea of leaving California to run for Congress in Texas, Republican Rep. Darrell Issa said Thursday he's staying put.

item.title: Three arrested in connection with shooting death in Linda Vista
item.description: Sara Benitez, 34, Adrian Alberto Flores Jr., 30, and Christopher Hensley, 32, were arrested for allegedly taking part in the slaying.

item.title: Data breach drives fears as advocates, councilmen urge end to use of police camera system
item.description: Over 50 advocates gathered Thursday, chanting "Get the Flock out," ahead of Tuesday’s city council meeting, where the contract is up for review.
